question: Refer to the exhibit. A Cisco Nexus 5600 Series switch experiences unexplained packet drops. An engineer configures a SPAN session to capture dropped packets. Which two command sets complete the configuration? (Choose two.)
options:
span session 2
 type SPAN-on-DROP
 destination interface ethernet 1/3
 source interface ethernet 1/16

monitor session 2 type SPAN-on-DROP
 destination interface ethernet 1/3
 source interface ethernet 1/16

monitor session 2
 destination interface ethernet 1/3
 span interface ethernet 1/16
theory: Capturing packets that are being dropped (rather than normally forwarded) requires a special SPAN session type, "SPAN-on-DROP," configured with "monitor session ... type SPAN-on-DROP" plus the usual source and destination interfaces. As with any SPAN session, the destination interface must also be explicitly enabled to receive mirrored traffic using "switchport monitor" under that interface — both the session-type configuration and the destination-port monitor enablement are required together to complete the capture. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 6 — SPAN Session Types)
